Technology & Equipments

Innovation isn't just about cool gadgets—it's about providing you with safer, faster, and more comfortable treatments.

3Shape TRIOS Intraoral Scanner

  • Creates precise digital impressions without messy traditional impression trays
  • Supports clearer treatment planning for crowns, aligners, and restorations
  • Helps patients see and understand their smile in real time

Gemini EVO Diode Laser

  • Soft tissue laser technology for cleaner, more comfortable procedures
  • Supports faster healing and reduced bleeding in gum treatments
  • Useful for gingivectomy, gum depigmentation, and frenectomy care

CJ Optik Microscope

  • High-magnification dentistry for precise diagnosis and treatment
  • Supports detailed work in endodontic and restorative procedures
  • Helps clinicians preserve healthy tooth structure whenever possible

EMS Airflow GBT

  • Guided biofilm therapy for a thorough, gentle cleaning experience
  • Removes plaque, stains, and biofilm with comfort-focused airflow technology
  • Ideal for hygiene visits, stain removal, and implant maintenance

Euronda E8 Pro System

  • High-grade sterilization system supporting strict infection control
  • Protects patients and clinicians through reliable instrument processing
  • Part of our commitment to a clean and safe treatment environment

Euroseal Infinity

  • Professional sealing system for sterilized dental instruments
  • Helps maintain instrument safety from sterilization through chairside use
  • Supports consistent clinical hygiene protocols

Eurosonic 4D

  • Ultrasonic cleaning system for detailed instrument preparation
  • Removes debris before sterilization for safer clinical workflows
  • Strengthens the clinic's infection-control process
